title: Symmetrized randomized decision tree
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-coordinate sign cube, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree that computes $f$ for every seed. The symmetrized tree uses a seed consisting of a symmetry of $f$ and an original seed; it applies the corresponding coordinate permutation to the selected tree and uses the joint law that chooses the symmetry uniformly and the original seed according to its seed law. It still computes $f$ for every seed.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the sign cube
